questions.title: Most Named Sounds
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts of GNIS features whose names include 'Sound' by state, covering marine straits between islands and mainland as well as broad estuarine passages.

questions.title: Largest Peak Snowpack (SWE)
questions.current_disclaimer: Average April 1 snow water equivalent across all SNOTEL sites in each state. April 1 is the traditional peak for the Western U.S. snowpack cycle.

questions.title: Most Craft Distilleries
questions.current_disclaimer: Count of DSP-licensed craft distilleries operating in each state (ACSA definition).

questions.title: Most Wineries
questions.current_disclaimer: Bonded winery count includes all TTB-permitted winery premises, from major producers to boutique operations.

questions.title: Most Farmers Markets
questions.current_disclaimer: Total count of currently listed farmers markets in the USDA Local Food Portal directory.

questions.title: Highest EV Share of New Vehicle Sales
questions.current_disclaimer: Battery-electric vehicles as share of new light-duty registrations; hybrids and plug-in hybrids excluded.

questions.title: Most Wind Capacity Installed
questions.current_disclaimer: Cumulative installed onshore + offshore wind nameplate capacity in gigawatts.

questions.title: Highest Residential Electricity Price
questions.current_disclaimer: Average residential retail price of electricity in cents per kilowatt-hour, all sectors annualized.

questions.title: Most ZIP Codes
questions.current_disclaimer: Total count includes standard, PO Box, unique (single-recipient) and military ZIP codes.

questions.title: Most Licensed Drivers
questions.current_disclaimer: Count of active licensed drivers (all classes) by state of residence, in millions.

questions.title: Highest Firearm Death Rate
questions.current_disclaimer: Deaths from all firearm-related injuries (suicide, homicide, accidental) per 100,000 residents, age-adjusted.

questions.title: Most Bird Species Observed
questions.current_disclaimer: Cumulative all-time count of species accepted on official state checklists.

questions.title: Most Native American Reservation Land Area
questions.current_disclaimer: Total federal trust and reservation acreage held for tribes and individuals; excludes Alaska Native Corporation lands (ANCSA) which have a different legal status.

questions.title: Most H-1B Approvals
questions.current_disclaimer: Number of initial + continuing H-1B approvals for beneficiaries whose worksite is located in each state.

questions.title: Most Pickleball Courts
questions.current_disclaimer: Total known playable courts including dedicated pickleball courts and tennis/multi-use courts lined for pickleball.

questions.title: Highest DUI Arrest Rate
questions.current_disclaimer: Driving-under-the-influence arrests per 100,000 residents. Rates reflect enforcement intensity and legal thresholds as much as underlying impaired-driving prevalence.

questions.title: Most Operating Nuclear Reactors
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts operating commercial reactors licensed by the NRC; excludes research reactors and units in decommissioning.

questions.title: Highest Coal Share of Electricity Generation
questions.current_disclaimer: Share of total electricity generated within the state that comes from coal-fired power plants; excludes imported power.

questions.title: Highest Natural Gas Share of Electricity
questions.current_disclaimer: Share of in-state electricity generation from natural gas; excludes imports and behind-the-meter generation.

questions.title: Highest Hydropower Share of Electricity
questions.current_disclaimer: Conventional hydroelectric only; excludes pumped-storage hydro (which is net-consumer of electricity).
